title: docs(agents): narrow the executor never-writes-assignee clause to the card's assignee
body:
Fixes #20076
Clause-②: no

## What changed

One clause in `AGENTS.md`, Multi-agent working discipline, the paragraph beginning "Claim the issue BEFORE you write any code":

- before: "... and it ⛔ never writes the assignee and ⛔ never yields a card it was dispatched to."
- after: "... and it ⛔ never writes the card's assignee (the PR's assignee mirrors the card's, set by the executor at pr_create) and ⛔ never yields a card it was dispatched to."

Nothing else in the paragraph, the file, or the repo is touched; no gate is added. Wording follows the maintainer-approved option A quoted on the card, aligned with the PR-assignee rule of #20063 (os-dev.md rule 2 / execution-duties.md). No issue or PR number enters AGENTS.md prose.

Line delta: +2 / -1 (net +1). The paragraph wraps at 91-98 columns; the 81 added characters exceed the slack of the whole paragraph at that width (68 columns), so net 0 would need a wider-than-house wrap or a reflow of every line. The minimal reflow splits only the one edited line into two; the following lines are byte-identical.

## Tier

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test AGENTS.md` answers GOVERNED, landing tier H: lands only by the maintainer's hand or an authorized APPROVED review, then the owning seat lands it. Draft; no ready flip, no enqueue from the executor.

## Verification (HEAD `74a02da9`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 15 families from the 1-path change set; all 15 run, each exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`: "15 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 15 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 15 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Includes `check:pm-governed-prose` (2 instruction surfaces name all 6 governed surfaces), `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:nul-bytes`. Also run beyond the derivation: `pnpm check:doc-authoring` exit 0 and `node scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` exit 0.

No changeset: AGENTS.md is a repo-root file on the fast-track list, ships in no package `files[]`.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:AGENTS.md 认领段里一句话:「派发来的执行者永不写 assignee」改成「永不写**卡的** assignee(PR 的 assignee 镜像卡的,由执行者在开 PR 时设)」。只动这一处,不加门禁。

**为什么改**:您已批准的 PR assignee 规则要求 dev 开 PR 时把 PR 的 assignee 设成与卡相同;原句单独读会和这条规则冲突,agent 可能因此不设 PR assignee,或反过来误改卡的 assignee。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文字,不影响任何运行时或门禁;净增 1 行。回滚即还原这一句。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:读上面这一句改动,同意则批准(APPROVED review)或直接合并。
